Alberta UCP by-election loss linked to vote split and separatism

The United Conservative Party (UCP) suffered a by-election loss in Calgary, Alberta. Premier Danielle Smith's office attributed the defeat to a split vote. However, critics and former Premier Jason Kenney pointed to the potential impact of a recent vote on Alberta separatism. The by-election was for a seat in the Alberta legislature.
